assertions.assertion: Registers the handler with AddSamlServiceProvider on the AddAuthentication builder
Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and also sets IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl (required when unsolicited responses are allowed)
assertions.rationale: Sets AllowUnsolicitedAuthnResponse = true and IdpInitiatedCallbackUrl, noted REQUIRED.

assertions.assertion: Callback authenticates against the external cookie scheme and reads RelayState from AuthenticationProperties.Items["relayState"]
Warns that RelayState is untrusted input and must be validated before being used as a redirect target
assertions.rationale: Comment 'RelayState is UNTRUSTED' with Url.IsLocalUrl/allow-list; 'never use as open redirect'.
